records.subject: Incorporation of amphiphilic networks and hygroscopic electrolytes
records.object: Operational stability across wide relative humidity
records.quote: Herein, we develop humidity-stable IH-QS thermocells via the incorporation of amphiphilic networks and hygroscopic electrolytes.
context_quotes: This design ensures operational stability across a wide relative humidity (RH) by synergistically combining hydrophilic & horbar;SO3 - groups and hygroscopic electrolytes for high water retention at low humidity and hydrophobic phenyl moieties that form physical crosslinks to suppress swelling at high humidity.
